About this Event

Join us February 21, 2027 for The Modern Bridal Expo San Antonio Riverwalk at The InterContinental San Antonio Riverwalk brought to you by Southern Event Productions. This exciting event is your one-stop shop for all things wedding. You'll find everything you need to plan your Texas dream wedding. Discover the latest trends in bridal fashion and meet talented vendors offering their services. Get inspired by the breathtaking decorations and sample delicious wedding cakes. Our knowledgeable experts will be on hand to answer any questions and provide guidance to make your special day unforgettable.

Also check out other Business events in San Antonio, Exhibitions in San Antonio.
